title: Central Excise Notification 44/2026: ATF Duty Revised to ₹19.5 per Litre
content:
# Central Excise Notification 44/2026: ATF Duty Revised to ₹19.5 per Litre

Ek important update hai! Government ne Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) ke exports par Special Additional Excise Duty (SAED) rates revise kiye hain. Central Excise Notification No. 44/2026 ke through, ye change announce kiya gaya hai.

Here are the key details:

*   **Notification Number:** 44/2026-Central Excise
*   **Notification Date:** 14th August 2026
*   **Effective Date:** This revised rate is effective from 15th August 2026.
*   **What's Changed:** The Special Additional Excise Duty (SAED) on exports of Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) has been fixed at ₹19.5 per litre.
*   **Amendment To:** This notification amends the existing Notification No. 08/2026-Central Excise, dated 26th March 2026.
